columns.name: coveragePct

columns.name: personnelDeployed

columns.name: suppliesUsed

columns.name: costUSD

columns.name: effectivenessScore

columns.name: communityCompliance

columns.name: mediaCoverage

columns.name: publicAwarenessScore

columns.name: transmissionReductionPct

columns.name: productnum
columns.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each fund product in the database.

columns.name: tickersym
columns.desc: Unique ticker symbol for the fund as traded on exchanges (e.g., 'SPY', 'VTI', 'QQQ'). Must be unique across all records.

columns.name: quotemode
columns.desc: TEXT. Type of security quotation or fund structure classification. All records are ETFs in this dataset. Possible values: ETF.

columns.name: geozone
columns.desc: TEXT. Geographic region or country focus of the fund's investments. All values represent United States with varying formats. Possible values: USA, US, United States, U.S., U.S.A., America, usa, us, UNITED_STATES.

columns.name: shortlabel
columns.desc: Abbreviated display name of the fund for user interfaces and brief references. Contains  NULL when short label is not available or fund uses only full description.

columns.name: fulldescription
columns.desc: Complete official name and description of the fund including investment objective and strategy details. Contains  NULL when detailed description is not available or pending.

columns.name: currencybase
columns.desc: TEXT. Base currency in which the fund is denominated and NAV is calculated. All values represent US Dollar with varying formats. Possible values: USD, US Dollar, US_DOLLAR, Usd, Dollar, US$, DOLLAR, usd, AmericanDollar.

columns.name: strategytype
columns.desc: TEXT. Investment style or strategy classification for equity funds, indicating the fund's approach to stock selection. Possible values: Growth, Value, Blend. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or strategy classification is not applicable (e.g., bond funds, sector funds).

columns.name: capsize
columns.desc: TEXT. Market capitalization focus of the fund's equity holdings, indicating the size category of companies the fund primarily invests in. Possible values: Small, Medium, Large. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or cap size classification is not applicable (e.g., bond funds).

columns.name: parentgroup
columns.desc: Foreign key referencing families.GroupName, indicating which fund family or asset management company manages this fund.

columns.name: listingvenue
columns.desc: Foreign key referencing exchanges.MarketCode, indicating the primary exchange where the fund is listed and traded.

columns.name: productclass
columns.desc: Foreign key referencing categories.ClassType, indicating the fund's investment category classification.

columns.name: networth
columns.desc: BIGINT. Total net asset value (NAV) of the fund in base currency units, representing assets under management. Example: 26004670464, 145110080, 8899219. Contains NULL when NAV data is not yet reported or fund is in liquidation process.

columns.name: yieldrate
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Distribution yield or dividend yield of the fund, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0467 = 4.67%). Example: 0.3153, 0.0061, 0.0454. Contains NULL when the fund does not distribute dividends or yield data is not yet calculated.

columns.name: launchdate
columns.desc: Date when the fund was first established and began operations (YYYY-MM-DD). Contains  NULL when launch date is not available or fund is in pre-launch phase.

columns.name: turnoverratio
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Annual portfolio turnover ratio indicating how frequently the fund trades its holdings, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.6 = 160% turnover). Example: 1.6, 0.43, 0.1879. Contains NULL when turnover data is not yet available or fund has insufficient trading history.

columns.name: strategynotes
columns.desc: Detailed text description of the fund's investment strategy, objectives, and methodology. Contains  NULL when strategy notes are not available or not provided by fund management.

columns.name: expensenet
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Net expense ratio representing the annual cost to investors after fee waivers and reimbursements, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0132 = 1.32%). Example: 0.0132, 0.0101, 0.0014. Contains NULL when expense ratio data is not yet reported or fund is too new to have established fees.

columns.name: benchmarkexp
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Benchmark expense ratio representing the cost of tracking the fund's benchmark index, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0022 = 0.22%). Example: 0.0022, 0.0028, 0.0038. Contains NULL when benchmark expense data is not available or fund does not track a benchmark index.

columns.name: vol3m
columns.desc: BIGINT. Average daily trading volume over the past 3 months, indicating liquidity and trading activity. Example: 43115, 499616, 705119.

columns.name: volrecent
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Most recent trading volume or current period volume figure. Example: 716570, 155510, 1961860. Contains NULL when recent volume data is not available or trading was halted.

columns.name: ma50
columns.desc: DECIMAL. 50-day moving average price of the fund, used for medium-term trend analysis. Example: 38.636, 147.557, 25.59. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history exists to calculate 50-day average.

columns.name: ma200
columns.desc: DECIMAL. 200-day moving average price of the fund, used for long-term trend analysis. Example: 56.79, 78.798, 39.194. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history exists to calculate 200-day average.

columns.name: equityweight
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Proportion of fund assets allocated to equity/stock holdings, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.9937 = 99.37%). Example: 0.9937, 0.9977, 0.1244. Contains NULL when asset allocation data is not available or fund structure does not support weight breakdown.

columns.name: bondweight
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Proportion of fund assets allocated to bond/fixed-income holdings, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.9977 = 99.77%). Example: 0.0697, 0.0934, 0.9977. Contains NULL when asset allocation data is not available or fund structure does not support weight breakdown.

columns.name: pb_ratio
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Price-to-book ratio of the fund's underlying equity holdings, indicating valuation relative to book value. Example: 1.6, 2.35, 4.32. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or P/B calculation is not applicable (e.g., bond funds).

columns.name: pcf_ratio
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Price-to-cash-flow ratio of the fund's underlying equity holdings, measuring valuation relative to operating cash flow. Example: 12.01, 16.22, 10.87. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or P/CF calculation is not applicable.

columns.name: pe_ratio
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Price-to-earnings ratio of the fund's underlying equity holdings, indicating valuation relative to earnings. Example: 10.87, 24.59, 34.94. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or P/E calculation is not applicable (e.g., bond funds, funds with negative earnings).

columns.name: ps_ratio
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Price-to-sales ratio of the fund's underlying equity holdings, measuring valuation relative to revenue. Example: 6.19, 0.64, 2.04. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or P/S calculation is not applicable.

columns.name: avgmaturity
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Average maturity period of bonds held in the fund portfolio, measured in years. Relevant for fixed-income funds to assess interest rate sensitivity. Example: 2.22, 5.13, 10.27. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold fixed-income securities or maturity data is not applicable (e.g., pure equity funds).

columns.name: duration
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Modified duration of the fund's bond portfolio, measuring sensitivity to interest rate changes in years. Higher values indicate greater interest rate risk. Example: 3.12, 2.73, 11.58. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold fixed-income securities or duration calculation is not applicable.

columns.name: fundclass
columns.desc: JSONB column. Consolidates fund classification and strategy information including geographic focus, investment strategy, market cap focus, and basic fund characteristics.

columns.name: fundmetrics
columns.desc: JSONB column. Groups fundamental financial metrics and operational data including assets under management, yield rates, expense ratios, and turnover statistics.

columns.name: tradingdata
columns.desc: JSONB column. Aggregates trading and market data including volume metrics and moving averages for technical analysis and liquidity assessment.

columns.name: allocweights
columns.desc: JSONB column. Contains asset allocation percentages and portfolio composition data including equity, bond weights and bond characteristics for portfolio analysis.

columns.name: valuationratios
columns.desc: JSONB column. Consolidates fundamental valuation ratios for equity holdings including price-to-book, price-to-earnings, price-to-cash-flow, and price-to-sales ratios.

columns.name: famcode
columns.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each fund family or asset management company in the database.

columns.name: groupname
columns.desc: Unique name of the fund family or asset management company (e.g., 'Vanguard', 'BlackRock', 'Fidelity'). Must be unique across all records.

columns.name: perfid
columns.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each fund performance record.

columns.name: productref
columns.desc: Foreign key referencing funds.TickerSym, ensuring 1:1 relationship for performance data per fund.

columns.name: reportdate
columns.desc: Date when the performance data was calculated or reported (YYYY-MM-DD). Contains  NULL when report date is not available.

columns.name: high52w
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Highest trading price reached in the past 52 weeks. Example: 30.6, 62.6, 52.17. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history exists for 52-week calculation.

columns.name: highdelta
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Absolute price difference between current price and 52-week high. Negative values indicate current price is below the high. Example: -2.9842, -6.348, -28.98. Contains NULL when 52-week high data is not available or calculation cannot be performed.

columns.name: highdeltapct
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Percentage difference between current price and 52-week high, expressed as a decimal. Negative values indicate distance below the high. Example: -0.03489, -0.39683, -0.06735. Contains NULL when 52-week high data is not available.

columns.name: low52w
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Lowest trading price reached in the past 52 weeks. Example: 30.6, 89.5, 24.59. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history exists for 52-week calculation.

columns.name: lowdelta
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Absolute price difference between current price and 52-week low. Positive values indicate current price is above the low. Example: 2.9145, 8.22, 11.7508. Contains NULL when 52-week low data is not available or calculation cannot be performed.

columns.name: lowdeltapct
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Percentage difference between current price and 52-week low, expressed as a decimal. Positive values indicate distance above the low. Example: 0.28562, 0.10058, 0.15487. Contains NULL when 52-week low data is not available.

columns.name: rangemove
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Absolute price range between 52-week high and low, indicating price volatility span. Example: 8.92, 107.982, 45.06. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history for 52-week range calculation.

columns.name: rangemovepct
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Percentage price range relative to 52-week low, measuring relative volatility. Example: 0.09161, 0.17467, 0.25442. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history for calculation.

columns.name: rytd
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Fund's year-to-date return, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.4286, -0.3981, 0.338. Contains NULL when YTD return data is not yet calculated or fund launched during current year.

columns.name: benchrytd
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Benchmark index year-to-date return, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0392, 0.1375, 0.1483. Contains NULL when benchmark YTD return data is not available.

columns.name: r1m
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Fund's return over the past 1 month, expressed as a decimal. Example: -0.049, 0.0805, 0.1031. Contains NULL when monthly return data is not yet calculated or fund was not trading for full month.

columns.name: benchr1m
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Benchmark index return over the past 1 month, expressed as a decimal. Negative values indicate losses. Example: 0.0128, -0.001, -0.0199. Contains NULL when benchmark return data is not available for the period.

columns.name: r3m
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Fund's return over the past 3 months, expressed as a decimal. Example: -0.049, -0.1339, -0.1841. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 3-month operating history or data is pending.

columns.name: benchr3m
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Benchmark index return over the past 3 months, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.032, 0.0562, -0.0519. Contains NULL when benchmark return data is not available for the period.

columns.name: r1y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Fund's return over the past 1 year, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.623, 0.4885, -0.2411. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 1-year operating history.

columns.name: benchr1y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Benchmark index return over the past 1 year, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0494, -0.0223, 0.1736. Contains NULL when benchmark return data is not available for the period.

columns.name: r3y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Fund's annualized return over 3 years, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.1576, 0.1197, 0.0593. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 3-year operating history.

columns.name: benchr3y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Benchmark index annualized return over 3 years, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0024, 0.0589, 0.1317. Contains NULL when benchmark does not have 3-year history or data is not available.

columns.name: r5y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Fund's annualized return over 5 years, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0454, 0.1031, 0.0854. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 5-year operating history.

columns.name: benchr5y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Benchmark index annualized return over 5 years, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.1576, 0.032, 0.1473. Contains NULL when benchmark does not have 5-year history or data is not available.

columns.name: r10y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Fund's annualized return over 10 years, expressed as a decimal. Negative values indicate losses. Example: 0.0061, 0.0454, -0.4632. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 10-year operating history.

columns.name: benchr10y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Benchmark index annualized return over 10 years, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0348 = 3.48%). Used for comparing fund performance against its benchmark. Example: 0.0348, 0.0467, 0.0703. Contains NULL when benchmark does not have 10-year history or benchmark data is not available.

columns.name: positiveyears
columns.desc: INTEGER. Count of calendar years with positive total returns since fund inception. Used to assess historical consistency. Example: 13, 18, 4. Contains NULL when historical annual return data is incomplete or fund is too new.

columns.name: negativeyears
columns.desc: INTEGER. Count of calendar years with negative total returns since fund inception. Used to assess historical downside frequency. Example: 13, 2, 9. Contains NULL when historical annual return data is incomplete or fund is too new.

columns.name: topholdings
columns.desc: TEXT. List or description of the fund's largest portfolio holdings by weight. Contains NULL when holdings data is not disclosed or fund does not report top holdings.

columns.name: topweight
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Combined weight percentage of top holdings in the portfolio. Contains NULL when holdings weight data is not disclosed or not applicable.

columns.name: pricerange52w
columns.desc: JSONB column. Groups 52-week price range data including highs, lows, deltas, and percentage changes for price movement analysis and volatility assessment.

columns.name: returnmetrics
columns.desc: JSONB column. Aggregates fund performance returns across different time periods including fund and benchmark returns for comprehensive performance comparison.

columns.name: histstats
columns.desc: JSONB column. Consolidates historical performance statistics including positive/negative year counts and top holdings information for fund analysis.

columns.desc: DECIMAL. Jensen's alpha measuring fund's risk-adjusted excess return over 3 years relative to its benchmark. Example: 10.87, -2.35, 4.32. Contains NULL when alpha calculation data is incomplete.

columns.desc: DECIMAL. Beta coefficient measuring fund's systematic risk relative to benchmark over 3 years. Example: -2.35, 0.43, 5.15. Contains NULL when beta calculation data is incomplete.

columns.desc: DECIMAL. Average annual return over 3 years, expressed as percentage points. Example: 0.43, 1.6, -1.32.

columns.desc: DECIMAL. Annualized standard deviation of returns over 3 years. Example: 12.01, 5.13, 25.59.

columns.desc: DECIMAL. Treynor ratio over 3 years. Example: 24.59, 16.13, -13.96.

columns.name: alpha5y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Jensen's alpha measuring fund's risk-adjusted excess return over 5 years relative to its benchmark. Example: -2.35, 1.81, 28.12. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 5-year history or benchmark data is unavailable.

columns.name: beta5y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Beta coefficient measuring fund's systematic risk relative to benchmark over 5 years. Example: -2.35, 3.18, 1.6. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 5-year history or benchmark data unavailable.

columns.name: avgreturn5y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Average annual return over 5 years, expressed as percentage points. Example: 1.6, 0.43, -1.44. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 5-year operating history.

columns.name: rsquared5y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. R-squared value over 5 years, expressed as percentage. Example: 98.8, 89.5, 52.17. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 5-year history.

columns.name: volatility5y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Annualized standard deviation of returns over 5 years. Example: 15.33, 40.25, 8.22. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 5-year history.

columns.name: sharperatio5y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Sharpe ratio over 5 years. Example: 0.89, 1.43, -1.41. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 5-year history.

columns.name: treynorratio5y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Treynor ratio over 5 years. Example: 0.84, -0.46, 17.81. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 5-year history.

columns.name: alpha10y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Jensen's alpha measuring fund's risk-adjusted excess return over 10 years relative to its benchmark. Positive values indicate outperformance. Example: -2.35, 1.81, 8.45. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 10-year history or benchmark comparison is not available.

columns.name: beta10y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Beta coefficient measuring fund's systematic risk/volatility relative to its benchmark over 10 years. Values >1 indicate higher volatility than benchmark. Example: 17.11, 0.43, 1.6. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 10-year history or benchmark comparison unavailable.

columns.name: avgreturn10y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Average annual return over 10 years, expressed as percentage points. Negative values indicate average losses. Example: 1.6, 0.43, -1.32. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 10-year operating history.

columns.name: rsquared10y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. R-squared value indicating how much of the fund's movement is explained by benchmark movement over 10 years, expressed as percentage (0-100). Example: 14.03, 69.04, 93. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 10-year history.

columns.name: volatility10y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Annualized standard deviation of returns over 10 years, measuring total risk/price variability. Higher values indicate greater volatility. Example: 16, 18.67, 30.86. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 10-year history.

columns.name: sharperatio10y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Sharpe ratio measuring risk-adjusted return over 10 years (excess return per unit of volatility). Higher values indicate better risk-adjusted performance. Example: -1.55, 0.35, 0.89. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 10-year history.

columns.name: treynorratio10y
columns.desc: DECIMAL. Treynor ratio measuring excess return per unit of systematic risk (beta) over 10 years. Example: 15.33, -11.05, 11.41. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 10-year history or beta is unavailable.

columns.name: stellarref
columns.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each host star record in the database. Maps to 'rowid' in source data.

columns.name: hostplname
columns.desc: The name of the host star system derived from 'pl_hostname'. VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE constraint ensures no duplicate star names. Examples include '11 Com', 'HD 114783', 'Kepler-1649'.

columns.name: stellardist
columns.desc: Distance to the host star measured in parsecs from 'st_dist'. REAL accommodating distances from 3.21 to 8500 parsecs. Contains  NULL when stellar distance measurements are unavailable or unreliable.

columns.name: compcount
columns.desc: Total number of confirmed planetary companions from 'pl_pnum'. INTEGER count of planets orbiting this host star, ranging from 1 to 8+ planets per system.

columns.name: coordsys
columns.desc: JSONB column. Consolidates all coordinate system information including both text and decimal representations of right ascension and declination, providing complete positional data for the host star.

columns.name: stellarprops
columns.desc: JSONB column. Groups all stellar physical properties and their measurement quality flags, including photometric, temperature, mass, and radius measurements with blend indicators.

columns.name: binaryRef
columns.desc: bigint. Primary key identifier for binary star system records. PK. Possible values: 11001, 11002, 11003, 11004, 11005, 11006.

columns.name: PRIMARY_STAR_LINK
columns.desc: bigint. Foreign key reference to the primary star in the binary system. FK to stars(STELLARREF). Possible values: 1, 17, 2396, 3, 5, 6.

columns.name: secondary_star_link
columns.desc: bigint. Foreign key reference to the secondary star in the binary system. FK to stars(STELLARREF). **NULL means secondary star is unresolved or below detection threshold.**. Possible values: 2.0, 32.0, 4.0, 7.0.

columns.name: SystemType
columns.desc: text. Classification of binary system type (visual, spectroscopic, eclipsing, etc.). Possible values: Astrometric Binary, Cataclysmic Variable, Contact Binary, Detached Binary, Semi-detached Binary, Spectroscopic Binary.

columns.name: ORBITAL_PERIOD_days
columns.desc: real. Orbital period of binary system in days. Example: 0.075.

columns.name: semi_major_axis_AU
columns.desc: real. Semi-major axis of binary orbit in astronomical units. Possible values: 0.005, 0.021, 0.08, 0.18, 0.35, 8.5.

columns.name: Eccentricity
columns.desc: real. Orbital eccentricity of binary system (0 = circular, approaching 1 = highly elliptical). Example: 0.01.

columns.name: INCLINATION_degrees
columns.desc: real. Orbital inclination angle in degrees relative to sky plane. Possible values: 45.0, 65.0, 78.9, 82.5, 85.2, 89.1.

columns.name: mass_ratio
columns.desc: real. Mass ratio of secondary to primary star (M2/M1). Possible values: 0.35, 0.65, 0.72, 0.78, 0.85, 0.92.

columns.name: FluxRatioVBand
columns.desc: real. Flux ratio of secondary to primary star in V-band. Possible values: 0.15, 0.45, 0.58, 0.62, 0.72, 0.88.

columns.name: SPECTROSCOPIC_BINARY
columns.desc: boolean. Flag indicating if system shows spectroscopic binary characteristics. Possible values: False, True.

columns.name: eclipsing_binary
columns.desc: boolean. Flag indicating if system shows eclipsing behavior. Possible values: False, True.

columns.name: MassTransferRate_solar_masses/year
columns.desc: real. Rate of mass transfer between binary components in solar masses per year. **NULL means no mass transfer detected or system is detached.**. Possible values: 2.3e-08, 5.8e-07.

columns.name: X_RAY_EMISSION_DETECTED
columns.desc: boolean. Flag indicating detection of X-ray emission from the system. **NULL means X-ray observations were not available.**. Possible values: False, True.

columns.name: systemic_radial_velocity_km/s
columns.desc: real. Systemic radial velocity of binary system center of mass in kilometers per second. Possible values: -12.5, -18.7, -5.2, 15.6, 22.1, 8.9.

columns.name: ProperMotionRa_mas/year
columns.desc: real. Proper motion in right ascension in milliarcseconds per year. Possible values: 12.4, 23.8, 34.1, 45.2, 67.3, 89.2.

columns.name: PROPER_MOTION_DEC_mas/year
columns.desc: real. Proper motion in declination in milliarcseconds per year. Possible values: -18.7, -25.8, -31.2, -42.5, -67.4, -8.9.

columns.name: discovery_method
columns.desc: text. Method used to discover or confirm the binary nature. Possible values: Astrometry, Eclipse Photometry, Radial Velocity, Spectroscopy, X-ray Detection.

columns.name: DiscoveryYear
columns.desc: bigint. Year when the binary system was first discovered. Example: 1987.

columns.name: CIRCUMBINARY_PLANET_POTENTIAL
columns.desc: boolean. Flag indicating potential for circumbinary planet existence. Possible values: False, True.

columns.name: habitable_zone_modification_factor
columns.desc: real. Factor by which binary nature modifies the habitable zone extent. **NULL means habitable zone modification not calculated.**. Possible values: 0.95, 1.25, 1.35.

columns.name: LastOrbitalUpdate
columns.desc: date. Date when orbital parameters were last updated. Possible values: 2023-08-15, 2023-09-30, 2023-10-18, 2023-11-20, 2023-12-05, 2024-01-10.

columns.name: NOTES
columns.desc: text. Additional notes or comments about the binary star system. **NULL means no additional observations were recorded.**. Example: Active M dwarf with flares.

columns.name: photometryRef
columns.desc: bigint. Primary key identifier for photometric variation records. PK. Possible values: 15001, 15002, 15003, 15004, 15005, 15006, 15007, 15008.

columns.name: STELLARLINK
columns.desc: bigint. Foreign key reference to the host star being monitored. FK to stars(STELLARREF). Example: 1.

columns.name: observation_date
columns.desc: timestamp. Precise timestamp of photometric observation. Example: 2023-03-15.

columns.name: MAGNITUDE_mag
columns.desc: real. Measured stellar magnitude in the observation. Possible values: 11.789, 12.456, 12.461, 14.756, 14.892, 16.187, 16.234, 18.456.

columns.name: magnitude_uncertainty_mag
columns.desc: real. Statistical uncertainty in magnitude measurement. Possible values: 0.005, 0.008, 0.009, 0.015, 0.018, 0.032, 0.035, 0.089.

columns.name: FluxValue_W/m²/Hz
columns.desc: real. Measured stellar flux in watts per square meter per Hertz. **NULL means flux calibration was not available.**. Possible values: 2.1e-13, 3.2e-12, 4.7e-14, 8.9e-13.

columns.name: FILTER_BAND
columns.desc: text. Photometric filter or bandpass used for observation (V, R, I, etc.). **NULL means filter information was not recorded.**. Possible values: B, I, R, U, V, g, r.

columns.name: effective_wavelength_micrometers
columns.desc: real. Effective wavelength of the photometric filter in micrometers. Possible values: 0.36, 0.44, 0.48, 0.55, 0.62, 0.64, 0.71, 0.79.

columns.name: ExposureTime_seconds
columns.desc: real. Duration of the photometric exposure in seconds. Possible values: 120, 180, 300, 600, 900.

columns.name: AIRMASS
columns.desc: real. Atmospheric airmass during observation affecting extinction. Example: 1.05.

columns.name: extinction_correction_mag
columns.desc: real. Correction applied for atmospheric extinction in magnitudes. **NULL means extinction correction was not applied.**. Possible values: 0.12, 0.15, 0.16, 0.18, 0.25, 0.28.

columns.name: SkyBackground_mag/arcsec²
columns.desc: real. Sky background brightness in magnitudes per square arcsecond. Possible values: 18.2, 19.8, 19.9, 20.3, 20.5, 21.8, 22.1, 22.5.

columns.name: SEEING_FWHM_arcseconds

columns.name: lens_star_mass_solar_masses
columns.desc: real. Estimated mass of the lensing star in solar mass units. **NULL means lens star mass could not be determined.**. Possible values: 0.29, 0.42, 0.58, 0.68, 0.75.

columns.name: LensStarDistance_kpc
columns.desc: real. Distance to the lens star in kiloparsecs. **NULL means lens distance could not be measured.**. Possible values: 3.5, 4.8, 5.2, 6.8, 7.2, 8.9.

columns.name: RELATIVE_PROPER_MOTION_mas/year

columns.name: angular_einstein_radius_mas
columns.desc: real. Angular Einstein radius of the lens in milliarcseconds. **NULL means Einstein radius could not be calculated.**. Possible values: 0.45, 0.62, 0.73, 0.85, 1.12, 1.45.

columns.name: PlanetaryMassRatio
columns.desc: real. Mass ratio of planet to host star (Mp/M*). **NULL means planetary signal was not detected.**. Possible values: 0.00012, 0.00034, 0.00085, 0.00089, 0.00156.

columns.name: PLANETARY_SEPARATION_Einstein_radii
columns.desc: real. Planet-star separation in units of Einstein radius. **NULL means planetary separation could not be determined.**. Possible values: 0.76, 0.89, 1.24, 1.55, 2.14.

columns.name: caustic_crossing_duration_hours
columns.desc: real. Duration of caustic crossing feature in hours. **NULL means no caustic crossing was detected.**. Possible values: 18.5, 2.8, 4.2.

columns.name: ParallaxDetection
columns.desc: boolean. Flag indicating detection of parallax effect in the event. **NULL means parallax analysis was not performed.**. Possible values: False, True.

columns.name: CHI_SQUARED_MINIMUM

columns.name: photometric_precision_mag

columns.name: TelescopeNetworksInvolved

columns.name: DISCOVERY_TEAM

columns.name: publication_status
columns.desc: text. Publication status of the discovery (published, submitted, in prep, etc.). Possible values: In Preparation, In Review, Published, Simulated.

columns.name: DataQualityAssessment
columns.desc: text. Assessment of data quality and reliability. **NULL means data quality was not assessed.**. Possible values: {"baseline_flux": 18.2}, {"photometry_quality": "excellent"}, {"snr": 245, "coverage": 0.89}, {"spitzer_parallax": true}.

columns.name: NOTES
columns.desc: text. Additional notes or comments about the microlensing event. **NULL means no additional observations were recorded.**. Example: Active M dwarf with flares.

columns.name: qualityref
columns.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each data quality record.

columns.name: targetlink
columns.desc: Foreign key INTEGER referencing planets(PlanetRef), linking quality metrics to a specific planet.

columns.name: perioderr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'pl_orbpererr1' in orbital period, in days. REAL representing +1σ error. Contains  NULL when period uncertainty is not available or period itself is unknown.

columns.name: perioderr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'pl_orbpererr2' in orbital period, in days. REAL representing -1σ error, typically stored as negative value. Contains  NULL when period uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: semimajerr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'pl_orbsmaxerr1' in semi-major axis, in AU. REAL representing +1σ error in orbital distance. Contains  NULL when semi-major axis uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: semimajerr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'pl_orbsmaxerr2' in semi-major axis, in AU. REAL representing -1σ error, accommodating asymmetric uncertainties. Contains  NULL when semi-major axis uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: eccerr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'pl_orbeccenerr1' in eccentricity. REAL representing +1σ error, typically small values <0.1. Contains  NULL when eccentricity uncertainty is not available or eccentricity is unconstrained.

columns.name: eccerr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'pl_orbeccenerr2' in eccentricity. REAL representing -1σ error, often asymmetric for low-eccentricity orbits. Contains  NULL when eccentricity uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: inclerr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'pl_orbinclerr1' in inclination, in degrees. REAL representing +1σ angular error. Contains  NULL when inclination uncertainty is not available or inclination is unconstrained.

columns.name: inclerr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'pl_orbinclerr2' in inclination, in degrees. REAL representing -1σ angular error. Contains  NULL when inclination uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: masserr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'pl_bmassjerr1' in planetary mass, in Jupiter masses. REAL representing +1σ error in mass measurement. Contains  NULL when mass uncertainty is not available or mass is unconstrained.

columns.name: masserr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'pl_bmassjerr2' in planetary mass, in Jupiter masses. REAL representing -1σ error, often asymmetric for low-mass planets. Contains  NULL when mass uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: raderr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'pl_radjerr1' in planetary radius, in Jupiter radii. REAL representing +1σ error in radius measurement. Contains  NULL when radius uncertainty is not available or radius is unconstrained.

columns.name: raderr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'pl_radjerr2' in planetary radius, in Jupiter radii. REAL representing -1σ error in radius measurement. Contains  NULL when radius uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: denserr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'pl_denserr1' in planetary density, in g/cm³. REAL representing +1σ error in density calculation. Contains  NULL when density uncertainty cannot be calculated due to missing mass or radius uncertainties.

columns.name: denserr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'pl_denserr2' in planetary density, in g/cm³. REAL representing -1σ error in density calculation. Contains  NULL when density uncertainty cannot be calculated.

columns.name: disterr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'st_disterr1' in stellar distance, in parsecs. REAL representing +1σ error in distance measurement. Contains  NULL when stellar distance uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: disterr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'st_disterr2' in stellar distance, in parsecs. REAL representing -1σ error in distance measurement. Contains  NULL when stellar distance uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: optmagerr
columns.desc: Uncertainty from 'st_optmagerr' in stellar magnitude. REAL representing symmetric 1σ error in magnitude measurement. Contains  NULL when magnitude uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: temperr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'st_tefferr1' in stellar temperature, in Kelvin. REAL representing +1σ error in temperature measurement. Contains  NULL when temperature uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: temperr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'st_tefferr2' in stellar temperature, in Kelvin. REAL representing -1σ error, accommodating larger negative uncertainties. Contains  NULL when temperature uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: stellarmasserr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'st_masserr1' in stellar mass, in solar masses. REAL representing +1σ error in stellar mass. Contains  NULL when stellar mass uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: stellarmasserr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'st_masserr2' in stellar mass, in solar masses. REAL representing -1σ error in stellar mass. Contains  NULL when stellar mass uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: stellarraderr1
columns.desc: Positive uncertainty from 'st_raderr1' in stellar radius, in solar radii. REAL representing +1σ error in stellar radius. Contains  NULL when stellar radius uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: stellarraderr2
columns.desc: Negative uncertainty from 'st_raderr2' in stellar radius, in solar radii. REAL representing -1σ error in stellar radius. Contains  NULL when stellar radius uncertainty is not available.

columns.name: masssource
columns.desc: Mass determination method from 'pl_bmassprov'. VARCHAR(50) with values: 'Msini' (minimum mass from radial velocity, M×sin(i)), 'Mass' (true mass from transit+RV or other methods), 'Msin(i)/sin(i)' (mass corrected for inclination). Contains  NULL when no mass measurement is available.

columns.name: updatestamp
columns.desc: Data update timestamp from 'rowupdate'. DATE field in YYYY-MM-DD format tracking when the record was last updated, with dates ranging from 2014-05-14 to 2016-07-07 in current dataset.

columns.name: limitflags
columns.desc: JSONB column. Consolidates all measurement limit flags indicating whether values represent actual measurements, upper limits, or lower limits for planetary and stellar parameters.

columns.name: physref
columns.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each physical properties record.

columns.name: objectlink
columns.desc: Foreign key INTEGER referencing planets(PlanetRef), linking physical parameters to a specific planet.

columns.name: massjup
columns.desc: Planetary mass from 'pl_bmassj' in Jupiter mass units. REAL covering range from 0.00006 MJ (sub-Earth) to 28.5 MJ (super-Jupiter). Contains  NULL when mass cannot be determined (e.g., for transit-only discoveries without radial velocity follow-up).

columns.name: radjup
columns.desc: Planetary radius from 'pl_radj' in Jupiter radius units. REAL covering range from 0.027 RJ (sub-Earth) to 6.9 RJ (inflated giants). Contains  NULL when radius cannot be measured (e.g., for radial velocity-only discoveries).

columns.name: densvalue
columns.desc: Bulk density from 'pl_dens' in g/cm³. REAL covering gas giants (<1 g/cm³) to super-dense planets (>20 g/cm³). Contains  NULL when both mass and radius are not available for density calculation.
